title: NFT-Game
tagline: Avenger NFT game that can be played by minting an avenger character to fight Thanos character. Thanos attacks back randomly that can make him win.
description:
In this Avenger NFT game, players can choose to mint their favorite Avenger character as their game avatar to battle against the formidable villain Thanos. The game is designed to be an interactive and thrilling experience for players, with unique and customizable Avenger character designs that players can choose from.
which can then be used to enter the virtual game arena. Once inside, players can take on the challenge of battling Thanos, who will randomly attack players during the game. The outcome of the game depends on the player's strategy and the luck of the draw, as Thanos can be a challenging opponent to defeat.
how_its_made: This project uses Scroll evm for storing and computing HP of villan(Thanos) and Hero(User Character NFT) on chain. It makes, attacking from both side much faster due to zk-rollup and reduce the transaction cost. On the frontend side, it uses Reactjs, etherjs library and Vanilla CSS to create a basic gaming arena.
